During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established a '''prison''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. The criminals [[Lyshaa]], [[Ryyk (Wookiee)|Ryyk]], and [[Sagoro Autem]] were placed in the [[Prison/Legends|facility]] prior to the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|Battle of Brentaal]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. After the prison was captured by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces under [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Shogar Tok]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] joined the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]' numbers.
